moon_base/all.explanation: Top-ranked [PSI-99] SAFFIRE-II (84.8/100) and second-ranked [PSI-98] SAFFIRE-I (84.3/100) lead the scenario because both match the ventilated airflow, achieve maximum richness scores, and test solid habitat materials. Third-ranked [PSI-68] FLEX-2 (77.0/100) also matches the ventilated airflow and scores full oxygen points since its tested 17–30% O₂ range covers the scenario's 30% O₂ requirement. However, [PSI-68] ranks lower than the top two because it evaluated liquid droplet fuels rather than solid habitat materials.

iss_cabin/all.explanation: [PSI-98] SAFFIRE-I and [PSI-99] SAFFIRE-II rank highest with identical total scores of 93.4/100 because both match the ventilated scenario's airflow (15/15), earn full marks for habitat materials (20/20) and richness (10/10), and test oxygen levels just 0.5 points away from the 21% target (34.4/35). [PSI-25] BASS-II ranks third with a total score of 82.0/100, earning full points for testing an oxygen range that includes the 21% target (35/35) and scoring higher on safety pillars (17/20), but receiving 0/15 for flow because its airflow was not reported.

spacesuit/all.explanation: SAFFIRE-I [PSI-98] ranks at the top with a total score of 49.0/100 by earning maximum points for solid habitat materials (20/20) and richness (10/10), alongside 14/20 for covering the prevention pillar and 5/15 for airflow. SAFFIRE-II [PSI-99] shares the top rank with an identical 49.0/100 total by achieving those exact same sub-scores across materials, richness, prevention, and airflow. SAFFIRE-III [PSI-100] also reaches a 49/100 total with matching sub-scores in those categories, despite testing a 30 cm/s airflow and having an unreported oxygen level.

moon_base/detection.explanation:
Ranking highest with a score of 65/100, [PSI-101] covers the detection focus, matches the ventilated scenario's airflow, tests habitat solid fuels like foam and Kapton, and achieves a top richness score of 10/10 with 109 test rows and 5 measurement types. 

In second place with a score of 64/100, [PSI-102] similarly covers the detection focus, matches ventilated airflow, and uses habitat solid fuels like silicone and Kapton, but receives a slightly lower richness score of 9/10 with 4 test rows and 4 measurement types. 

Lastly, [PSI-60] ranks third with a score of 28/100 because, despite covering the detection focus, its airflow is unreported, its fuels are gaseous with no habitat materials named, and it scores only 2/10 in richness with no experimental table and 2 measurement types.
